title: calendula suffruticosa subsp. monardii
intro: Calendula suffruticosa subsp. monardii, commonly known as American marigold, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family and is characterized by its bright orange and yellow flowers. The health benefits of Calendula suffruticosa subsp. monardii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and promote tissue repair. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal actions, which can aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and infections. Bioactive constituents of Calendula suffruticosa subsp. monardii include triterpenoids, sesquiterpenes, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
